spans.s: प्रति—धी mfn. (ifc.) as intelligent as, Pracaṇḍ.
प्रति-√ धी (only pf. -दिधिम), to expect, hope, RV.
प्रति-˚धी mfn. See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति˚धि॑ m. a cross-piece on the pole of a carriage, RV.; VS.
प्रति—धुर m. a horse harnessed by the side of another, VS., Sch. (cf. अप्रतिध्˚).
प्रति-˚धुक्—त्व n., TS.
प्रति˚धा॑ f. putting to the lips, a draught, RV.
प्रति˚धान n. (ifc.) putting to or on Gobh.
adopting precautions, Kull.

प्रति-√ धाव् P. Ā. -धावति, ˚ते, to run back, AV.;
to rush upon (acc.), attack, MBh.; R.
प्रति-˚धावन n. rushing upon, onset, attack, MBh. (v.l. -बाधन).

प्रति-√ धृ P. Ā. -धारयति, ˚ते, to keep back, stop, check, ŚBr.;
to keep erect, support, AitBr.
प्रति-˚धर्तृ॑ m. one who keeps back or stops, VS.
प्रति-√ धृष् (only pf. -दधर्ष and Ved. inf. -धृ॑षे), to be bold against, brave, defy, RV.; Kāṭh. (cf. अ-प्रतिधृष्ट and ˚धृष्य).
thought upon, meditated, MBh. (v.l. प्र-ध्यात).
echo, reverberated sound, Hcar.
प्रति-˚ध्वान m. (n., L.) id., Hit.
प्रति-˚ध्वानित (Nāg.) mfn. sounding, resounding.
प्रति-˚ध्वानिन् (Sāh.) mfn. sounding, resounding.
sunk, hanging down, MBh.
